title: Andrew Shue, Marilee Fiebig marry weeks after exes Amy Robach, T.J. Holmes – Reports

Holmes – Reports
 KiMi Robinson USA TODAY Nov. 1, 2026, 9:32 p.m. ET Hear this story Andrew Shue and Marilee Fiebig , the ex-spouses of T.J. Holmes and Amy Robach , are reportedly married.
 Shue and Fiebig tied the knot in a wedding that took place at his New Jersey estate on Sunday, Nov. 1, according to photos obtained by the Daily Mail . People also confirmed the "Melrose Place" star and lawyer were married in the ceremony.
 USA TODAY has reached out to Shue for comment.
 The news comes more than a week after the two announced their engagement in an interview with People magazine , published Oct. 21, and more than a month after their exes, Holmes and Robach, quietly married on Sept. 19 in Washington County, Arkansas.
 "We're very grateful and hopeful," Shue, 59, told People about their engagement. "I don't know how it happened, but there's a happy ending."

Reflecting on his former marriage to Robach, Shue told People that he "had to accept my own part in marriage not working out for me and in not understanding myself well enough and not understanding what matters in a relationship well enough to find the right person for me."
 "I had to grow through a lot of pain and a lot of struggle and a lot of humility," Shue continued. "I think the magic of love is when you go from a need to giving."
 'Just this kind of freak luck': Andrew Shue opens up about his relationship with Marilee Fiebig He described that when he and Fiebig were first getting to know each other, they were "able to share ourselves with each other in a time where we both needed a friend."
 How Marilee Fiebig and Andrew Shue met through T.J. Holmes, Amy Robach
 Nearly four years ago, the two were thrust into the spotlight as Holmes and Robach faced intense media scrutiny after being photographed  holding hands in public in November 2022. At the time, the "Good Morning America" hosts were still married to Fiebig and Shue, respectively, but Holmes and Robach have maintained that their prior marriages were nearly over when their romance began.
 Because of the paparazzi photos, ABC News removed Holmes and Robach from "GMA3." In a December 2022 internal memo, the network said that while their relationship did not violate company policy, it had become "an internal and an external distraction." The network ousted the pair the following month.
 Holmes filed for divorce from Fiebig in December 2022. Robach has said she was separated from Andrew Shue in summer 2022, and they reportedly finalized her divorce in March 2023.
 Fiebig and Holmes share a daughter, Sabine, who was photographed at her mom's wedding to Shue.
